description: US-3: single-focal-point moves from level 2 (fail) to level 0 (pass), so its change is better. faint-body-text stays fail but its defect probability rises from 0.75 to 0.95, so it is worse by value. faint-chart-labels stays warn and its defect probability moves from 0.96 to 0.9, less than 0.15, so it is the same. The after answer of line-length has a confidence of 0.5, below its min_confidence of 0.6, so its after verdict is uncertain and, as a choice criterion, its change is uncertain. The four criteria give one change of each kind, the summary counts them, and skipped is empty because both runs skip the same criterion (FR-35, FR-36, FR-37, FR-39, section 8.2).
